The Empire Story

Uncompromising Luxury

Embrace a sanctuary of elegant hospitality located in the tranquil valleys of Domchanch. From panoramic vistas of native hills to carefully detailed suite designs, every corner of Hotel HMT Empire represents comfort and high-class grandeur.

Whether you are holding an intimate celebration, a business summit, or simply looking for a restful getaway with family, our dedicated hospitality team is available round-the-clock to ensure your expectations are always exceeded.
